shared_identity.name: Combat Woodblock
shared_identity.linework: Thick carved outlines with readable silhouettes, selective fine hatching, and restrained contour detail.
shared_identity.texture: Warm fibrous paper, imperfect ink density, flat layered color, and visible registration character without fake damage obscuring information.

packs.label: Woodblock Anime Action
packs.audience_job: Make a decisive exchange, contact point, momentum shift, or tactical mistake immediately legible without relying on skeletal figures or generated instructional text.

layout_rules: Use one dominant action silhouette per panel and preserve full limb ownership.
Reserve a clean edge or paper inset for local contact, force, score, or correction overlays.
Matched comparisons keep the same camera and start pose while changing only the decisive variable.
Technique sequences use anticipation, contact, recoil, and result panels rather than continuous generated choreography.

production.fallback: Use reviewed key poses as a four-panel woodblock comic with local arrows and contact markers; do not generate continuous multi-person choreography.

packs.prompt_core: Original woodblock-print anime action illustration with carved indigo and rust silhouettes, warm paper, flat registered color, strong body ownership, one decisive combat action, and clean local overlay space.
negative_constraints: no generated logos or academy marks
no extra limbs, fused hands, or ambiguous body ownership
no camera shake or moving background plate

packs.label: Woodblock Historical Editorial
packs.audience_job: Create a coherent illustrated historical world that can carry people, journeys, institutions, documents, uncertainty, and sourced chronology without pretending illustration is evidence.

layout_rules: Build foreground, character plane, architecture or terrain, and atmosphere as separable layers.
Reserve paper fields, scroll edges, sun discs, or framed insets for local evidence surfaces.
Historical reconstructions remain visibly illustrated and are never treated as source material.
Travel worlds communicate atmosphere and direction while reviewed overlays own exact routes and dates.

production.fallback: Use the approved clean world with a static illustrated character pose and locally rendered fact folio; never replace missing evidence with generated detail.

packs.prompt_core: Original historical woodblock editorial illustration with warm paper, deep indigo, muted rust and ochre, carved outlines, layered period world-building, stable character staging, and deliberate blank evidence anchors.
negative_constraints: no generated text, handwriting, or captions
no generated labels, citations, or route names
no generated logos, flags, or organization marks
no camera shake or whole-background drift

packs.label: Woodblock Comic Whitespace
packs.audience_job: Turn approved people, screenshots, products, documents, or event facts into a fast branded explainer while preserving enough whitespace for late-breaking local editorial inserts.

layout_rules: Use one anchor illustration and one large paper field rather than generating a complete cinematic world.
Accept modular approved cutouts, screenshots, charts, archive frames, and icon stickers in named slots.
Reuse the same title, color-icon, question, comparison, and source-card layouts across rapid responses.
Keep the primary subject inside the safe center so one composition supports landscape and vertical outputs.

production.fallback: Use the recurring paper field, one approved subject cutout, a local headline folio, and a direct hard cut; do not generate a filler background.

packs.prompt_core: Original modular woodblock comic composition with warm paper, carved indigo and rust accents, one strong subject silhouette, forty to sixty-five percent clean whitespace, and reusable editorial insert zones.
negative_constraints: no generated labels, charts, or citations
no generated logos or brand marks
no camera shake or decorative motion without meaning
